title: Python Syntax Essentials
intro: Python syntax interview questions are the first thing every fresher interview hits — before OOP, before frameworks, before any framework question. This page covers the Python data types every candidate should know cold (int, float, str, bool, NoneType, and the distinction between mutable and immutable), operators (arithmetic, comparison, logical, bitwise, the is vs == trap), control flow (if/elif/else, for loops, while loops, break/continue/pass), function definition (def, default arguments, *args and **kwargs at a concept level), variable scope (LEGB rule explained simply), and the string methods that come up in every fresher screen (split, join, strip, replace, format, f-strings). Every answer ends with what the interviewer is really asking — because fresher interviewers often phrase the same concept three different ways to see if you actually understand it or just memorised it.
